note: The commercial profile of each enterprise platform in the six fields a buyer needs. 'status' is published (a public page states it), quote (the vendor quotes it per customer), included/addon/preview (MCP access only) or unknown. 'confirmed' is false where the fact comes from the person who supplied the link and was not on a page that was opened. Numbers for published prices are kept in core/mcp/platform_docs.json (pricing.facts) so there is one source for them.

base_license.text: Integration Suite is sold as a subscription or pay-as-you-go (per the supplied link; the page blocked automated reading, so no figure is recorded).
base_license.ask: Which Integration Suite plan and edition, what minimum commitment, and what is the unit price for messages or connections?

mcp_access.text: The Integration Suite MCP Gateway is included in eligible service plans, per the supplied link. Availability depends on the plan.
mcp_access.ask: Is the MCP Gateway in our plan, or an add-on?

api_consumption.text: Consumption is metered (messages, connections, API calls) by plan; no public figures were readable.
api_consumption.ask: What is metered for our plan, and what is the overage price?

ai_consumption.text: AI services (for example AI Core) have their own consumption units; none were readable.
ai_consumption.ask: Which AI units apply and at what price?

environment_costs.text: Not stated on any page that was read.
environment_costs.ask: What do non-production subaccounts and sandboxes cost?

limits_overage.text: Not stated on any page that was read.
limits_overage.ask: What are the rate limits, concurrency limits and overage terms?

base_license.text: The Pega pricing page publishes no prices or units; pricing is by quote.
base_license.ask: What is the platform subscription, the minimum commitment and the term?

mcp_access.text: The MCP page describes Infinity Build MCP and Infinity Run MCP and makes no licensing statement.
mcp_access.ask: Are Build MCP and Run MCP included in our subscription, an add-on, or in preview?

ai_consumption.text: Pega describes case-based, predictable AI pricing; an illustrative figure of $0.88 per case was supplied by the person who gave the link and is not on the pricing page.
ai_consumption.ask: What is the price per case for AI-assisted work, and under what assumptions?

environment_costs.ask: What do development, test and production environments cost?

limits_overage.ask: What are the limits on cases, users and API rate, and the overage terms?

base_license.text: Agentforce user licence $5 per user per month (requires Flex Credits); Sales, Service, Field Service and Operations add-ons $125 per user per month; Industries add-ons $150; Max editions from $550 per user per month.

mcp_access.text: The Agentforce pricing page makes no MCP-specific statement. Salesforce-hosted MCP servers are generally available for Enterprise Edition and above (Salesforce developer blog, April 2026).
mcp_access.ask: Do hosted MCP servers or the Agentforce MCP client carry any charge beyond Agentforce credits?

api_consumption.text: Each org has a daily API request allowance by edition and licences; SolsArch reads the org's actual allowance from its limits when an org is connected.
api_consumption.ask: What is our org's API request allowance and the price of more?

ai_consumption.text: Flex Credits $500 per 100,000 credits; a standard Agentforce action uses 20 credits (voice 30); conversations $2 each. Conversation pricing, add-ons and Agentforce 1 Editions are not available with pay-as-you-go or pre-commit.

environment_costs.text: Sandbox pricing is not on the pricing page.
environment_costs.ask: What do sandboxes cost for our edition?

limits_overage.text: Buying models are pre-purchase, pre-commit and pay-as-you-go; overage terms depend on the model.
limits_overage.ask: What happens when credits or API requests run out under our model?

base_license.text: Anypoint is quote-based; the vCore page covers metering, not prices, and sources disagree on whether new customers still buy vCores.
base_license.ask: What is the Anypoint subscription and what is it metered on (vCores, messages, API calls)?

mcp_access.text: MuleSoft MCP servers sync into Salesforce's API Catalog (per MuleSoft's blog); no licensing statement was read.
mcp_access.ask: Is MCP server hosting or the AI gateway priced separately?

api_consumption.text: vCore usage is sampled hourly and the peak is used for the daily and monthly maximum (MuleSoft docs); no price is public.
api_consumption.ask: What is the price per vCore or per message under our contract?

ai_consumption.ask: Do agent fabric or AI features consume credits?

environment_costs.ask: Are sandbox and design environments included?

limits_overage.ask: What are the overage terms for vCores or messages?

base_license.text: No public price list; the documentation links product tiers (Foundation, Advanced, Prime).
base_license.ask: Which tier and how many licences, with what term?

mcp_access.text: Per the supplied link, the MCP server is included in Now Assist and AI-native SKUs; the documentation says access depends on the licence.
mcp_access.ask: Is the MCP Server Console in our SKU?

api_consumption.text: REST API access (Table and CMDB APIs) works on every instance without a Now Assist entitlement; rate limits are set per instance.
api_consumption.ask: What REST rate limits are set on our instance?

ai_consumption.text: Per the supplied link, AI actions consume Assist currency, so included MCP access is not unlimited AI use.
ai_consumption.ask: How many Assists are in our SKU and what does an action cost?

limits_overage.ask: What are the Assist and API limits and overage terms?

base_license.text: Negotiated enterprise subscription; no public price.
base_license.ask: What is the subscription by worker count and modules?

mcp_access.text: The Agent-Ready Tools page has no licensing statement; availability per tenant should be confirmed with Workday.
mcp_access.ask: Is MCP access for Agent-Ready Tools included, an add-on or in preview for our tenant?

api_consumption.ask: Is API or tool use metered?

ai_consumption.ask: Do agent actions consume AI credits?

environment_costs.ask: What do sandbox and implementation tenants cost?

limits_overage.ask: What are the rate limits and overage terms?

base_license.text: The Fusion Cloud global price list is a public PDF; it returned no readable text to an automated request, so no figure is recorded. OCI list prices are public (see the OCI price list).
base_license.ask: Which Fusion applications and metrics, and what discount applies to the list price?

mcp_access.text: No standalone MCP fee is established for the Fusion Data Intelligence MCP server; it needs the relevant Fusion Data Intelligence entitlement.
mcp_access.ask: Is the MCP server covered by our Data Intelligence entitlement?

ai_consumption.text: Not stated; OCI AI services are priced per unit in the OCI price list.
ai_consumption.ask: Which AI features in our entitlement are metered?

environment_costs.ask: What do test and development pods cost?

limits_overage.ask: What are the limits and overage terms?
